_note: One continuous shot for the clip behind the landing hero. Landscape 16:9, framed so she sits just right of centre — a phone crops a 16:9 hero to its middle third, so anything at the edges is lost there. The left third stays empty for the headline, and the encode grades that area down. Nothing legible is allowed in frame: the headline sits on top of this, and text behind text makes both unreadable.

01-merchant.title: A merchant in her kedai, phone in hand
01-merchant.frame_prompt: A Malaysian Malay woman wearing a soft dark tudung (hijab) stands in a warm, dim mamak kedai makan at night, holding a smartphone in one hand, looking down at it with a slight smile. The phone screen is dark and switched off — nothing on it is readable. Shot from a slight angle, three-quarters from the side, her face partly out of frame and softly out of focus. Warm tungsten lamps glow behind her, the background falls away into deep shadow, strong shallow depth of field. Wide landscape composition: she stands just right of the centre of the frame, close to the middle, and the whole left third of the frame is empty, dark, unoccupied space. Cinematic, photorealistic, warm amber highlights on a very dark background. No text anywhere, no signage, no menu boards, no writing, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no on-screen captions.
01-merchant.video_prompt: A slow, steady push-in toward her. She shifts her weight slightly and her thumb moves once on the phone; her smile stays gentle. Warm lamplight flickers softly behind her and faint steam drifts through the background. Her face stays partly out of frame and soft throughout. The phone screen stays dark and unreadable. She stays just right of centre for the whole shot and never drifts to the edge of the frame; the left third stays empty and dark throughout. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: no text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no signage, no menu boards, no writing on walls, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no captions or subtitles. Nothing readable may appear anywhere in frame at any point. Cinematic, photorealistic, warm tungsten light, very dark background, shallow depth of field, unhurried.
